subject.title: fix(cron): command jobs no longer warn about missing agents

question: Should this protected maintainer-labelled cron warning fix be accepted after a maintainer confirms that Gateway command jobs intentionally require no agent context?
rationale: The patch is narrow and its stated contract is plausible, but protected-label policy and incomplete source/history inspection mean automation should not make the merge decision.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Confirm that command payloads execute without agent context, then accept the focused warning exclusion and regression test.

options.title: Request stronger runtime evidence
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal capture or log showing the command cron creation, zero warning output, and successful execution before deciding.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm that command payloads execute without agent context, then accept the focused warning exclusion and regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this person with the proposed cron implementation and the maintainer-labelled review path.
